description:
`pkix-lint` exists as a standalone advisory lint engine. Should it integrate into `verify()` as another policy, or run in parallel?

**Options:**

- **A) `policies::lint_catalog(&catalog)` is a `VerificationPolicy` adapter.** Lint findings appear in the same `VerifyReport.findings` vec alongside path/revocation/profile findings. One pipeline, one report. The survey recommended this.
- **B) Parallel pipeline.** `verify()` returns chain outcome; caller invokes `pkix-lint::LintRunner` separately for advisory findings. Two reports, more wiring. Preserves stronger separation: "trust decision" vs "advisory findings."

A is the lower-friction shape for users who want a single call. B is the purist shape that keeps `verify()` purely about trust verdict.

Concrete impact: if A, then `verify()` is the one-stop shop and lint findings can influence the outcome rollup (via severity); if B, then `pkix-lint` findings never affect verdict.

Decision-gate. Human label inherited from parent.
title: Decide lint integration model (VerificationPolicy adapter vs parallel)
